answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the yarrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. A ledge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the timber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
